note: Background Studio runs on the Mac. Shot from a second copy started like start.sh with BGSTUDIO_DATA pointed at a scratch folder, --port 8865 --no-browser, its output set to a scratch folder, and eight made-up scans of trip keepsakes (tickets, stamps, stickers, a postcard, a cup). Sort & tag was set up with five categories and five pictures tagged. Scratch paths are shown as the defaults.

steps: eval:[...document.querySelectorAll('p')].filter(p => /Saved to/.test(p.textContent)).forEach(p => p.textContent = p.textContent.replace(/Saved to .*/, 'Saved to ~/Pictures/Background Studio Output'))
